text:
[NDET.1.4] **Only admitted double arithmetic carries the guarantee.** A
target's double arithmetic — a hardware FPU, a coprocessor, an SDK's routines or
a library — is part of a release row only once it has been shown correct on that
target, against the archive that row ships. Acceleration is not excluded;
unshown acceleration is. A build that uses double arithmetic not admitted for its
target is outside the guarantee.

alloy.name: ndet_1_4__no_signalling_operand
alloy.note: The admission's one exclusion made sound: under [LEXP.4.2], [LCST.4.5.8], [LGRA.5.8.10], [LDET.3.6.2] and [RDSC.9.10]'s refusal of a NaN in an artefact's `double` fields, no Float operand either runtime computes on is a signalling NaN, so TestFloat's signalling-NaN inputs are inputs DS cannot present. Bounded at ten operands; the derivation is finite, so the scope is one of depth, not of kind. No hypothesis outside the spec remains: [RDSC.9.10] gates the artefact's fields, and `probe__lying_artefact` runs the refuted branch without it.
